description:
## Context

Two autocomplete providers are fully implemented but never instantiated:

1. `OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete.ExtensionCommandProvider` (`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/autocomplete/extension_command_provider.ex`)
   - Filters extension commands by `/prefix`, excludes conflicts with builtin commands

2. `OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete.FilePathProvider` (`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/autocomplete/file_path_provider.ex`)
   - Handles `@prefix` for file fuzzy matching, absolute paths, and relative paths
   - Native recursive walk, no external `fd` dependency

The existing provider chain:
- `CombinedProvider` — flattens + deduplicates suggestions from multiple providers
- `SlashCommandProvider` — only currently wired provider
- `build_autocomplete_provider/2` in `interactive.ex` (~line 744) — constructs the provider at startup

Upstream: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/autocomplete.ts` `CombinedAutocompleteProvider` (lines 270-783)

## Implementation steps

### 1. Read build_autocomplete_provider/2 before modifying

Read `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` around line 744. Understand:
- Current structure and how extension commands are extracted for `SlashCommandProvider`
- How `loaded_resources` and `extensions` are shaped
- What `Dispatcher.get_registered_commands/1` (or equivalent) returns

Also read `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/autocomplete/combined_provider.ex` to confirm `CombinedProvider.new/1` takes a list of providers.

### 2. Update build_autocomplete_provider/2

Replace the current body with:

```elixir
defp build_autocomplete_provider(loaded_resources, extensions \\ []) do
  # 1. Slash commands (existing logic — keep)
  template_commands = ...existing...
  extension_commands_for_slash = ...existing...
  slash_provider = SlashCommandProvider.new(
    Autocomplete.builtin_commands() ++ template_commands ++ extension_commands_for_slash
  )

  # 2. Extension command provider (conflict detection)
  builtin_names = Autocomplete.builtin_commands() |> Enum.map(& &1.name) |> MapSet.new()
  # Derive 3-tuples {name, spec_map, extension_id} from same extension source
  ext_cmd_tuples = derive_extension_command_tuples(extensions)
  ext_cmd_provider = ExtensionCommandProvider.new(ext_cmd_tuples, builtin_names)

  # 3. File path provider
  file_provider = FilePathProvider.new(cwd: File.cwd!(), max_results: 50)

  CombinedProvider.new([slash_provider, ext_cmd_provider, file_provider])
end
```

### 3. Add imports

At the top of `interactive.ex`:
```elixir
alias OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete.CombinedProvider
alias OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete.ExtensionCommandProvider
alias OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete.FilePathProvider
```

### 4. Derive extension command tuples

`ExtensionCommandProvider.new/2` expects `[{name :: String.t(), spec :: map(), extension_id :: String.t()}]`.

Inspect what the extension command source currently provides (it feeds `SlashCommandProvider` already) and add a transformation if the format differs.

### 5. Update return type annotation

```elixir
@spec build_autocomplete_provider(map() | nil, [term()]) :: CombinedProvider.t()
```

### 6. Tests

- Typing `@file` returns file path suggestions (FilePathProvider active)
- Typing `/ext-cmd` returns extension command suggestions
- Extension command conflicting with builtin is suppressed (not shown)
- Typing plain text shows no spurious suggestions (CombinedProvider dedup)

## Notes
- `@` prefix handling is internal to `FilePathProvider.get_suggestions/2` — no changes needed to dispatch layer.
- CombinedProvider deduplicates by `value`, preventing false overlaps between providers.
- If `Dispatcher.get_registered_commands/1` doesn't exist, search for how extension commands reach `SlashCommandProvider` and replicate that path.
title: Wire ExtensionCommandProvider and FilePathProvider into combined autocomplete
